hoaxes.title: ElevenLabs launches a voice that reads app terms and conditions aloud before you can tap Accept
hoaxes.truth: Made up. ElevenLabs is reportedly in early talks to raise money at a $33 billion valuation, Bloomberg reports.

hoaxes.title: Lionsgate sells a Hunger Games popcorn bucket that only opens after a three-minute countdown
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Sunrise on the Reaping reached $148.2 million in North America in its first five days, Gold Derby reports.

hoaxes.title: Sony sells life-size cardboard PS5s for Black Friday shoppers who cannot find the real one
hoaxes.truth: Made up. PS5 consoles reportedly sold out at major US retailers in the week after GTA VI's launch.

hoaxes.title: WhatsApp's new scheduling feature lets you send messages up to 14 years in advance
hoaxes.truth: Made up. WhatsApp now lets users schedule messages from 10 minutes to 14 days ahead, TechCrunch reports.
